common.estimateOnly: Estimate only. Not a valuation, appraisal, quality-of-earnings report, tax or legal advice.
common.unavailable: This part of Exit-Ready is not set up yet. Apply the latest database migrations, then refresh.

evidence.title: Evidence and lineage
evidence.intro: Every figure below is computed from your own records with a stated as-of time, the logic used, the number of source records and a content hash. Re-check any figure to confirm it still reproduces.
evidence.noRun: No evidence check has been run yet. Run it to compute your figures, reconciliations and readiness gaps.
evidence.verifiedMatch: Reproduced: the figure still computes to the same value.
evidence.verifiedDrift: Changed: the underlying records are different now. Stored {{stored}} records, now {{now}}.
evidence.reconIntro: Differences are shown, not hidden. A difference is a prompt to review, not proof of an error.
evidence.evidenceScoreHint: 100 minus weighted penalties for gaps. Unknown items count half.
evidence.signalsNote: Shown beside the readiness score, not blended into it, so past snapshots stay comparable.
evidence.movedNone: No driver moved by 3 points or more.
evidence.changelogFirst: This is the first evidence check, so there is nothing to compare yet.
evidence.exportHelp: Excel and PDF contain the same sheets: summary, KPI book, lineage, reconciliation, AR aging, recurring revenue, add-backs, readiness and changelog.
evidence.addbackIntro: Attach documents from your vault to each add-back. Buyers see document titles only, and only after you approve the NDA stage.
evidence.addbackNone: No add-backs yet. Add them on the Estimate tab.
evidence.noDocs: Your vault has no documents yet.

multiples.title: Valuation multiples
multiples.intro: Multiples are inputs you control. Each needs a source and the date it was published. Nothing here is a market fact.
multiples.noBand: No size band yet (no invoiced revenue).
multiples.empty: No rows yet. Without a row the built-in placeholder is used and labelled illustrative.
multiples.sourceHelp: A broker report, an advisor memo, a transaction database.
multiples.markIllustrativeHint: Leave on unless this is a signed, current figure from your advisor.

sharing.title: Secure sharing
sharing.intro: Share in stages. Buyers first see a banded teaser. After they accept your NDA they see aggregated figures. You approve the detailed stage yourself, per link. Nothing is ever sent for you.
sharing.legalNote: Have your lawyer review the NDA text and your privacy obligations for customer data before sharing. Vireek provides tools, not legal advice, and does not supply NDA wording.
sharing.name: Room name
sharing.recipientHelp: Used for the watermark and your own log. Not sent anywhere.
sharing.ndaHelp: Paste the NDA your lawyer approved. Recipients must accept it to see the next stage. At least 50 characters.
sharing.needRun: Run the evidence check first. A staged room is built from the latest run, which must be under 24 hours old.
sharing.readyTitle: Your link is ready. Copy it now.
sharing.readyHelp: For security the full link is shown only once. It opens only the teaser until you move the room to the next stage.
sharing.detailedHelp: This builds a frozen snapshot now. Aggregated figures are already visible at the NDA stage; the detailed stage adds line-level sections.
sharing.piiLevel: Customer data in the detailed stage
sharing.piiNamedWarning: Named disclosure shares personal data about your customers and staff. Confirm your privacy-law basis with your lawyer first.
sharing.needNdaFirst: The recipient must accept the NDA before you can approve the detailed stage.
sharing.revokeBody: The recipient loses access immediately and any detailed snapshot is deleted. This cannot be undone, but you can create a new room.
sharing.docsIntro: Choose which vault documents a room can open and from which stage. Every view is logged.
sharing.viewOnlyNote: View-only is a deterrent. Recipients can still copy what they can see, so rely on your NDA, not on the screen.
sharing.futureNote: A buyer marketplace is deliberately not part of this release. It is a separate decision to make later.

public.disclaimer: Estimates only. Not a valuation, appraisal, quality-of-earnings report, tax or legal advice.
public.viewOnly: View-only. Do not copy, forward or share.
public.ndaIntro: Read the agreement below. Accepting records your name, email and the time.
public.ndaAgree: I have read and agree to this NDA
public.ndaError: Could not record your acceptance. Check your details and try again.
public.figuresIntro: Each figure shows when it was computed, how many records it comes from and its content hash.
